entries.html: Agent — handles tasks directly by default instead of proactively launching subagents; delegation now needs an explicit request in your message, AGENTS.md, a skill, or an enabled multi-agent mode
AgentSwarm — the agent can no longer launch it on its own; swarms now start only when swarm mode is turned on, so they’re unavailable in kimi -p or ACP clients such as Zed
KIMI_CODE_SESSION_LOCK — set to 0 to turn off the cross-process lock that stops two processes writing the same session
/sessions / /resume — after a retry, offers to take over a session still held by an exited process; session-in-use errors name the holding client
sessions occasionally remaining occupied after an application crash on macOS and Linux
workspace trust prompt — no longer fails when Git Bash is unavailable on Windows
auto_session_title — auto-generates a session title after the first turn and shows it as the terminal window title; a global config.toml gate and an independent tui.toml opt-out
[mcp] default_deferred — defaults every MCP server’s tools to on-demand loading when the experimental tool-select flag is on
/model — switching models mid-session with history can show a confirmation dialog, gated by cloud configuration
/compact — now queues while the agent is busy instead of failing with an error
/skill:<name> — plugin skills are listed and invoked only under their qualified plugin-id:skill-name form; a bare plugin-skill name no longer resolves
disable_feedback_survey — moved from tui.toml to config.toml
[permission].dangerous_command_guard — set to false now disables every built-in guard, not only the dangerous-command check
[[hooks]] — hook commands now run in the session’s project directory instead of the server’s startup directory
kimi app [path] — opens a new desktop chat in the current or a given directory; needs a desktop app version that supports it
KIMI_CODE_TRUST_WORKSPACE — marks the current workspace as trusted for this process, like the interactive trust prompt
Ctrl-P / Ctrl-N Updates panel — now shows opt-in mid-turn progress updates, off by default and toggled from /experiments
Ctrl-S — also sends a highlighted skill prompt, replacing the old skill-suggestion cards
tui_mode fullscreen — a scrolled-out user message gets a sticky one-line summary; clicking it jumps back to the original message
[background] — the agent’s in-turn wait for a task is capped at 90 seconds and discourages repeated waits; a new message ends the wait early
Ctrl-C — forces an immediate exit during shutdown hooks instead of waiting for the hook timeout; a “Shutting down” hint shows meanwhile
UserPromptSubmit hook — fixed turn ordering and rendering when the hook injects text; hook JSON without a message field is no longer added to the conversation
forked sessions — cron tasks from the source session no longer fire inside a fork
executor = "kaos" — removed from MCP stdio configuration (never implemented); configs using it now fail validation at load time
tui_mode (/settings → TUI mode) — experimental fullscreen TUI layout; click a folded block to toggle it, with a clickable “Jump to bottom” indicator
KIMI_CODE_TUI_FULL_SCREEN — removed now that fullscreen is a tui_mode setting instead of an env flag
KIMI_CODE_REPEAT_BREAKER — set to 0 to stop reminders and forced stops for repeated tool calls
[workspace].additional_dir — rejects directories that resolve to the home directory or filesystem root

hardened workspace security: file tools can no longer escape the working directory via symlinks, project-local config only applies once the workspace is trusted, and background git operations can no longer run commands from repository git config
reduced the CLI’s startup time and memory usage
[watch] / KIMI_CODE_WATCH — briefly defaulted to off in 2.1.0; reverted to on by default in 2.1.1
/resume — new messages no longer land at an old position in the conversation after resuming a session
/compact — no longer fails after switching to a model with a smaller context window
the agent no longer assumes the current working directory is the project root
a message sent while the agent was running no longer sometimes appears twice in the chat
[watch] / KIMI_CODE_WATCH — disable filesystem watchers for local.toml, AGENTS.md, skills and MCP config entirely
[providers."<id>"] — api_key_env names an environment variable to read the API key from, as an alternative to api_key
[database] — searchSyncSessionCap / searchSyncDebounceMs tune the incremental background search-sync pass (marked unverified — not yet in the config reference)
/yolo / -y, --yolo — Ask When Needed no longer prompts for a Bash command that cannot be statically analyzed
kimi install-app — renamed to kimi install-desktop; the old name keeps working as a hidden alias
/desktop / /install-desktop — opens the Kimi Code desktop app page in your browser
kimi install-app — prints and opens the desktop app page (renamed to kimi install-desktop in 2.0.1)
[markdown].mermaid — renders fenced mermaid code blocks in the terminal as diagrams (marked unverified — not yet in the config reference)
/copy — native clipboard write path for Linux X11 sessions
Ctrl-C while subagents are running now interrupts only the subagents, instead of exiting the whole CLI
/sessions — Ctrl-X then y deletes the selected session from the picker
kimi upgrade / kimi update — -y, --yes skips the confirmation prompt and installs directly
loop_control.compaction_max_attempts — caps total attempts for a failing compaction request; default 5
KIMI_CODE_PERMISSION_MODE_REMINDER env var — set to 0 to stop injecting auto permission-mode reminders into the model context
Ctrl-S — a steering message can now interrupt a wait for a background task
/goal — the time budget no longer counts time spent with the session closed, and the 24-hour limit is removed
card-keys — initial reference: the seven keyboard-shortcut contexts, from general input to the approval panel (19 rows)
card-slash-core — initial reference: account, session, mode and status commands with their aliases (33 rows)
card-slash-tools — initial reference: swarm and goal control, extensibility, and the built-in skill commands (16 rows)
card-cli — initial reference: all 14 top-level flags and all 12 subcommands (25 rows)
card-settings — initial reference: config.toml, tui.toml and .kimi-code/local.toml (37 rows)
card-env — initial reference: core paths, model overrides, runtime switches and diagnostics (22 rows)
card-skills — initial reference: skill and agent directories, the four AGENTS.md locations, plugins (18 rows)
card-hooks — initial reference: 18 hook events, hook exit codes, mcp.json and MCP permissions (20 rows)
KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_REMOTE_CONTROL and KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_SECONDARY_MODEL — Remote Control and the subagent model pool are always on in 0.42.0, so both flags were removed
[database] replaces the experimental minidb flags; the read model and search worker are now controlled by KIMI_CODE_PERSISTENCE_MINIDB_READMODEL and KIMI_CODE_SEARCH_WORKER
[read] — configurable character limits and resumable long-line file reads, replacing repeated output truncation
Ctrl-O — finished tool calls collapse to a header plus one outcome row; hidden output is counted and revealed here
